title: BAFF
description: This mod adds a new vanilla-styled powerful tool and armor tier named Akarium, and with Akarium you could do more things alongside tools and armor. And also, a recipe book hidden in a structure with blue roofs and no windows that can be found in villages.
body:
This mod adds a new vanilla-styled powerful tool and armor tier named Akarium, and with Akarium you could do more things alongside tools and armor. And also, a recipe book hidden in a structure with blue roofs and no windows that can be found in villages.

## The game version will most likely not change. 
It is highly likely that the mod will only remain available for version 1.20.1 and for Forge.

 

## Mod is made on version 1.20.1
Trying the mod on other versions of 1.20 is up to you.

 

New versions of the mod may be released.

###### think twice when adding this mod to your game
